source: Owner photo of the panic report screen
trigger: Three-finger hold on the transfer page after choosing no transfer
device_page: Transfer Your Apps & Data; the upper-right spinner was still animating

setup_relaunch.note: The language-change restart also killed Setup, which relaunched as PID 394. The SBRestartManager code matches the SpringBoard exit seen in v80.

owner_observation: The spinner kept turning after 'Don't Transfer Apps & Data' and taps were still answered very slowly.

derived.note: 548 copies carry a 19.6 MB full frame each, so the copy is about 327 ms regardless of the 366x176 changed area. accountsd and akd are idle in CFRunLoop waits, so they are not handling a Setup request at the sample.

limits: Only one thread per service was visited, so a request on another accountsd or akd thread would not be visible.
The panic-screen report is a single sample; it does not show whether the transfer page would advance later.
The 21H461 cache symbols identify the wait functions, not the peer that would answer the Setup dispatch_mach request.
